# nationality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:nationality`](gmeow-nationality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/nationality>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/entities`](../../slices/entities.md)

The country of a person's nationality ([schema:nationality](https://schema.org/nationality)) — a [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md). The legal/national-identity bond, distinct from where a person currently lives. Non-functional: a person may hold several nationalities; contested cases are standpoint-indexed claims ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
